quote.text: Religious knowledge will be taken away (by the death of Religious learned men).

shots.framing: HOOK. Medium: a librarian (woman, 50s, headscarf) pulling a chain through the library door handles; dust in the air
shots.vo: The libraries closed on a Monday.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The chain sliding through the handles, her hands
shots.notes: Alive from frame 0 (chain already moving). Lock clicks on "Monday".

shots.framing: Wide: the library steps; children play ball, ignoring the chained door; posters fading
shots.vo_markup: By Friday, no one remembered why they had been *open.*
shots.vo: By Friday, no one remembered why they had been open.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Kids running past the chained door
shots.notes: Ball bounces off the door on "open".

shots.framing: Medium: an old teacher (glasses, peci) at a window closing his book, looking out
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The closing book, his tired face in profile

shots.framing: Wide: a small, sparse funeral in a cemetery; a stack of books beside the fresh grave
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Few mourners; the books by the grave
shots.notes: A mourner places the last book on "died". No body shown.

shots.framing: Medium: an empty classroom, one empty teacher's chair, dust beams; a piece of chalk rolls off the ledge
shots.vo: And no one took their place.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The empty chair; the falling chalk

shots.framing: Medium: children clapping and chanting in a circle around a young leader with a drum; an unopened book lies in the dust
shots.vo: Children learned chants instead of letters.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The circle of clapping kids; the closed book in the foreground

shots.framing: Medium: at home, a small girl holds up a book to her father; he gently turns off the lamp
shots.vo_markup: Parents stopped asking questions they couldn't *answer.*
shots.vo: Parents stopped asking questions they couldn't answer.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The book held up; the lamp going out

shots.framing: Wide: an excavation on a hill; workers with shovels uncover a stone head
shots.vo_markup: And on the hill outside the city, something old was *uncovered.*
shots.vo: And on the hill outside the city, something old was uncovered.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The weathered stone head emerging from the soil

shots.framing: Medium-wide: the whole stone figure revealed (generic, weathered, abstract; NOT resembling any real deity or religion), a rope around it
shots.vo_markup: A stone figure, buried for centuries.
shots.vo: A stone figure, buried for centuries.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The figure looming over the workers

shots.framing: Wide: visitors with umbrellas behind the rope, pointing and looking
shots.vo_markup: At first, people only came to *look.*
shots.vo: At first, people only came to look.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.notes: A child lifted on shoulders on "look".

shots.framing: Close: hands laying flowers at the base of the statue at dusk
shots.speaker: narr
shots.notes: A hand places a flower on "flowers". Flowers only (no incense, no ritual objects of any real faith).

shots.framing: Top-down at dusk: a ring of people slowly circling the statue
shots.vo_markup: Then they began to walk around it… slowly… in *circles.*
shots.vo: Then they began to walk around it… slowly… in circles.
shots.speaker: narr

shots.framing: Close: a woman (simple face) joining the circle, calm, eyes half closed
shots.vo_markup: No one told them to. It just felt *right.*
shots.vo: No one told them to. It just felt right.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Her calm profile in the dusk light
shots.notes: She steps into the ring on "right".

shots.framing: Wide: the statue silhouetted against the dusk sky on the hill, the city small below
shots.vo_markup: The Prophet said that before the Hour, knowledge would be taken away, ignorance would spread, and some would return to the idols of old.
shots.vo: The Prophet said that before the Hour, knowledge would be taken away, ignorance would spread, and some would return to the idols of old.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The silhouette of the statue and the circling ring
shots.notes: QUOTE overlay (top ~15–40%): keep the upper area dark and calm.

shots.framing: Wide: rain sweeping over green fields; farmers looking up, laughing
shots.vo: That spring, the rain came early.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Rain curtain arriving; faces turned up

shots.framing: Wide: golden rice fields, harvesters, overflowing carts
shots.vo_markup: The harvest was the biggest anyone had ever *seen.*
shots.vo: The harvest was the biggest anyone had ever seen.
shots.speaker: narr

shots.framing: Medium: a warehouse where sacks of money pile up; a merchant laughing; banknotes fluttering in the air
shots.vo_markup: And with it came more money than anyone knew what to do *with.*
shots.vo: And with it came more money than anyone knew what to do with.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The growing pile of sacks; notes fluttering
shots.notes: A sack tips and notes burst out on "with". Generic, unreadable banknotes.

shots.speaker: narr
shots.notes: Same title design as previous chapters.
